release_notes:
VERSION 2.1.0 - Design Overhaul & New Tools

NEW LOOK:
- Sidebar navigation grouped by section, replacing top tabs
- Centralized theme system with light/dark modes and 10 accent colors
- Toast notifications stack in the bottom-right (replaces fading status bar)
- Card-based layouts on every page
- Press Ctrl+K to open a fuzzy command palette

NEW TOOLS:
- Mod Profiles: save and switch named mod loadouts in one click
- Manifest Auto-fix: actually apply fixes (fx_version, lua54, dedupe deps)
- Live Log Tailer: color-coded server.log with regex filtering
- server.cfg Editor: friendly form for common convars + ensure/stop toggles
- Dependency Graph: surfaces missing deps and circular dependencies
- Resource Scaffolder: generate basic/ESX/QBCore resources from a template
- Locale Checker: find missing translations and orphaned references
- Backup History: dated snapshots with file-level diff

QUALITY OF LIFE:
- Recent paths dropdown on every folder picker
- Drag-and-drop folders onto inputs
- Markdown export for reports
- In-app changelog viewer

UNDER THE HOOD:
- 28 new unit tests (60 total)
- All worker-thread UI updates now use typed Signals
